name: edge-add-refuses-existing
body: `apg edge add <kind> <from> <to> …` must refuse when the source node's file already carries an out-edge with the same `(kind, from, to)`, with an error naming the duplicate and the correct follow-up (`apg edge update` for properties, `apg edge rm` to remove). Today `edge_add` (src/node_cmd.rs:139–174) unconditionally pushes an OutEdge onto the source and a matching InEdge onto the target with no dedup, so re-adding duplicates the edge on both halves. Acceptance: re-adding an identical `(kind, from, to)` exits non-zero and writes nothing; the source still has exactly one out-half and the target exactly one in-half.
